pads.name: AVDD-PC
pads.connect: Pin10 -> 1uF +/-10% -> 20ohm +/-5% -> GND. Do not tie directly to +3V3.

pads.name: DVDD-PC
pads.connect: 1.5uF +/-10% to GND. Do not tie directly to +3V3.

application_notes: AMG8833 is 3.3V +/-0.3V high-gain variant; do not use 5V AMG8853 assumptions.
Manufacturer circuit uses 10k +/-5% pull-ups for SDA, SCL and INT. Use one shared bus pull-up pair; choose actual resistance from bus capacitance and clock speed.
Keep pin9/13 at identical supply voltage; AVDD-PC and DVDD-PC are internal regulator capacitor nodes, not external power inputs.
Use wide, short ground connections and keep all local capacitors near sensor.
Pin1 is a no-connect mechanical pad and is deliberately longer in the manufacturer's recommended PCB land pattern.
